sources.org: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union, with Eurostat
sources.title: Data on Taxation Trends: National Tax Lists (NTL), edition 2026
sources.note: Workbook "NTL edition 2026 web.xlsx", sheet BG: every tax and social contribution by its national name and ESA code, in BGN million. Data cut-off 30 October 2025.

sources.title: Main national accounts tax aggregates (gov_10a_taxag)
sources.note: Taxes and social contributions by sub-sector and ESA item. For Bulgaria the July 2026 release is in euro; dividing the National Tax List’s leva by 1.95583 gives the same totals. Used to place each tax at a level.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Bulgaria – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary, not an official source: corporate income tax a flat 10%.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Bulgaria – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: a flat tax rate of 10% on all personal income, with some exceptions.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Bulgaria – Corporate – Other taxes
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: VAT standard rate 20%, reduced rate 9%.
